title: Clarify why delivered state is idempotent in update_delivery_state
description: Lines 292-319 in kith-store/src/message.rs branch on three cases when UPDATE touches 0 rows: already Delivered (idempotent return Ok), doesn't exist (error), or unexpected state (internal error). New contributors need to understand WHY we distinguish delivered from nonexistent — the answer is that Delivered is terminal and idempotent by contract, not just by chance. Add a comment before the match explaining this invariant.
